# Fonts

The Text tool's built-in fonts (T), Regular and Bold each:

* `NotoSans-*.ttf` — Noto Sans
* `NotoSerif-*.ttf` — Noto Serif
* `NotoSansThai-*.ttf` — Noto Sans Thai (Thai letters; others come from Noto Sans)
* `NotoSansSymbols-Regular.ttf`, `NotoSansSymbols2-Regular.ttf` — Noto Sans Symbols / Symbols 2 (♥ ☺ ★ ♪…: the
  Text panel's Symbols grid, and the fallback for symbols a font hasn't got; Regular only)

Copyright 2010-2020 (Symbols: 2017) Google Inc. / Google LLC (https://notofonts.github.io). Licensed under the SIL Open
Font License, Version 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org).

* `Pacifico-Regular.ttf` — Pacifico, and `Lobster-Regular.ttf` — Lobster: script fonts whose letters join up (a name
  keychain in one piece; Regular only)

Pacifico: Copyright 2018 The Pacifico Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/Pacifico). Lobster: Copyright 2010
The Lobster Project Authors (https://github.com/impallari/The-Lobster-Font), with Reserved Font Name "Lobster". Both
licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org).
